terms.definition: The charge stored per unit potential difference, C = Q/V.
terms.examiner: The farad is one coulomb per volt.

terms.definition: The product CR: the time for the charge, p.d. or current of a discharging capacitor to fall to 1/e (about 37%) of its initial value.
terms.examiner: τ = CR. After 0.69CR the value has halved.
